summary: OpenAI announced that GPT-5.6 will become the new preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Chat and Cowork, with Microsoft accessing the model via the OpenAI API.

mechanisms.reason: Making GPT-5.6 the preferred model across Microsoft 365's mass-market productivity apps expands the surface serving inference to a very large existing user base.
mechanisms.quote: Microsoft 365 is where millions of people write, analyze, create, and collaborate every day

categories.reason: The announcement centers on Microsoft accessing OpenAI's frontier model directly through the API to power its own platform products.
categories.quote: In addition to serving the models natively, Microsoft will also access OpenAI models directly through the API to bring GPT‑5.6 to Microsoft 365 customers.
